dialogue_texts: Doromi
Ha... ahahaha! Talk about an absolute powerhouse.
Doromi
You don't just spark - you completely rewrite the atmosphere.
Doromi
That mini-reactor of yours is a fascinating piece of work.
Marisa
Cut the chatter. Your danmaku's completely spent, and you're wide open.
Marisa
Do I need to give that fancy coat of yours a close-up look at a Final Spark?
Doromi
Let us see if your spark can pierce the eternal shroud!
Marisa
Hey! Don't you dare ignore me!
Marisa
Drop the cryptic bad-guy routine and look me in the eye when I'm talking to you!
Marisa
I'm the one running this investigation!
Doromi
Heh... You honestly believe blowing away a few layers of danmaku means you've won?
Doromi
The Order's roots go much deeper than these shallow graves, My Majesty.
Doromi
The boundary is already fractured beyond repair.
Marisa
Broken or not, if you're gonna block the road, I'll just have to blast a new path straight through ya. Move it!
